messages:
samir: hey team, first-week question — kicked off the `payments` Buildkite pipeline and the checkout step fails with a 403 / 'repository access denied'. i'm listed in the org and accepted the invite but the job says remote: Repository not found. any quick checks?

anya: welcome Samir! usual things: add your SSH pubkey to GitHub, confirm SSO, and accept the org GitHub App installation (ci-runner). also check if your account email matches the invite.

samir: i added my SSH key earlier but still seeing the 403. log snippet: ```fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address
remote: Repository not found.
```

anya: hm — does the pipeline use a GitHub App or a PAT on the agent? we recently flipped some projects to use the org GH App which needs the user to be in the `ci-access` team so the app grants repo access for PR builds. i'll check your membership.

infra-bot: infra:issue created #2620 "Grant samir membership to ci-access and verify GH App install on payments" (assignee: anya)

samir: also seeing a warning about 'self-hosted runner lacks write permission to refs' in the job environment. i thought checkout should be read-only.

anya: that warning means the runner is using a deploy key with read/write by default; we prefer read-only keys for CI. but the 403 is separate — it means the clone request used HTTPS or the app didn't include the repo. run `git remote -v` in your fork to see if it's forcing https.

samir: local remote is SSH (`git@github.com:samir/payments.git`). buildkite job logs show it attempted `https://github.com/redwood/payments.git`.

anya: pipeline has a checkout hook that rewrites remotes for some PR workflows. i'll update it to prefer SSH for private repos. i'm also re-inviting you to `ci-access`.

deploy-bot: GitHub: invited samir to team `ci-access`

samir: invite accepted and i re-added SSH pubkey (ed25519). re-ran the pipeline.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `payments/push` #58 failed on job `checkout` — exit code 128 — fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address

anya: dang, still hitting HTTPS. can you paste the exact pipeline step config? sometimes our plugin sets GIT_URL to https for mirror repos.

samir: config snippet pasted: `plugins: - git#v3: {depth: 50}` and the step sets `repository: redwood/payments` (no ssh override).

anya: okay i'll push a tiny change to the pipeline to set `ssh_key: agent` for that step and flip the git plugin to use SSH remotes. give it a minute.

infra-bot: infra:patch deployed to pipeline hooks for `payments` repo to prefer SSH remotes

samir: rebuild triggered — now the checkout step passed!! :tada: build is progressing.

anya: sweet. root causes were: GH App not covering the repo until you were in `ci-access`, and pipeline checkout plugin defaulting to HTTPS for PR mirror clones. notes for onboarding: add SSH key, accept GH App, join `ci-access`, and we should check the git plugin defaults in the new-hire doc. i'll open a small docs PR.

samir: thanks all — appreciate the speedy help. i'll add the checklist note and link this thread.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `payments/push` #59 succeeded on job `checkout` — duration 41s
